title: Slugify
goal: Provide one function, slugify(text), that turns a title into a lower-case ASCII URL slug.
non_goals: Transliteration of scripts that have no ASCII decomposition.
A command-line interface or a package release.

use_cases.title: Turn a title into a slug
preconditions: The caller has imported slugify from slugify.py.
main_flow: The caller passes a string to slugify().
The function removes accents, lower-cases the text and replaces every run of other characters with one hyphen.
The function returns the slug without leading or trailing hyphens.

alternate_flows.title: Nothing usable in the input
steps: The function returns an empty string.

error_flows.title: The value is not a string
steps: The function raises TypeError and returns nothing.

postconditions: The result contains only a-z, 0-9 and single hyphens between words.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Every test in test_slugify.py passes with /usr/bin/python3 -m unittest -q.
test_slugify.py is byte-identical to the approved base commit.

nfrs.statement: Only the Python standard library is used and no network access is needed.

assumptions.statement: The system Python at /usr/bin/python3 is version 3.9 or later.
